core.title: Stainless Steel Egg Door Knobset, AHI SIG081

text.description_html:
AHI SIG081 Stainless Steel Egg Door Knob

Charming with a simple elegance, the AHI made Stainless Steel Egg Door Knobset is available in either satin stainless steel or polished stainless steel finishes. Stainless steel is extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches, and abrasions. Since it does not degrade in appearance or function even after many years of hard use, this knobset can be used in any commercial or residential setting where durability and style are desired. The SIG081 Egg Knob is available in passage, privacy, and dummy functions. Easy to install, it will fit standard door preparations. This knob and rose set can be adjusted for 1-3/8 inch to 2 inch thick doors with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets.

Features of the AHI SIG081 Stainless Steel Egg Knobsets:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Good for both residential and commercial applications.
  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).

Specifications of the SIG081 Stainless Steel Egg Door Knob:

  • Spindle Width: 0.31" (8 mm)
  • Rose Diameter: 2.52" (64 mm)
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" to 2"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a door pull or to match trim. Trim is on one side of the door. Knob is surface mounted (mounting plate screws to the doors face).
  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door knobs on both sides of the door. For use with a standard 2-1/8" bore hole pre-drilled door.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of the door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side of the door. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside knobs will the release privacy push button and retract the door latch.
